_note: Update the openings below as roles are filled or added. Set "openings" to an empty array when nothing is live — the page handles that case.

openings.title: Production Engineer — Extrusion
openings.summary: Own line output, compound changeovers and dimensional control across the PVC and XLPO extrusion lines.
responsibilities: Run daily production planning for the extrusion lines
Hold wall thickness and eccentricity within drawing tolerance
Work with QA on non-conformance closure

openings.title: Quality Assurance Executive
openings.summary: Run the in-house test lab and keep batch records audit-ready against IS, IEC and customer specifications.
responsibilities: Perform conductor resistance, hipot, IR and ageing tests
Support customer and certification body audits

openings.title: Harness Assembly Supervisor
openings.summary: Lead the harness shop floor: crimp quality, form-board discipline and 100% electrical testing before dispatch.
responsibilities: Supervise cut, strip, crimp and assembly operations
Monitor crimp height and pull-force against specification
Train operators to IPC/WHMA-A-620 workmanship classes
Own first-article documentation for new builds

openings.title: Export Sales Executive
openings.summary: Develop OEM and distributor accounts across our cordset and cable export markets.
responsibilities: Build the pipeline for cordset and cable export enquiries
Translate customer drawings into internal specifications
Coordinate samples, approvals and first shipments

benefits.title: Learn the whole process
benefits.detail: Copper drawing, stranding, extrusion, assembly and testing all happen under one roof, so engineers see the full chain rather than one station.

benefits.title: Standards-led work
benefits.detail: Everything is built against a written standard — IS, IEC, JASO, EN or a customer drawing. Decisions are backed by test data, not opinion.

benefits.title: Stable, long-term teams
benefits.detail: Many of our supervisors have been on the floor for over a decade. We hire to keep people, not to churn them.

benefits.title: Safety first, always
benefits.detail: Machine guarding, PPE discipline and electrical safety training are non-negotiable across every shift.
